name: cdm/product/template/TransferableProduct
description: A TransferableProduct is a type of financial product which can be held or transferred, represented as an Asset with the addition of specific EconomicTerms.

Cash.description: An Asset that consists solely of a monetary holding in a currency.

Commodity.description: An Asset comprised of raw or refined materials or agricultural products, eg gold, oil or wheat.

DigitalAsset.description: An Asset that exists only in digital form, eg Bitcoin or Ethereum; excludes the digital representation of other Assets.

economicTerms.description: The price forming features, including payouts and provisions.

Instrument.description: An asset that is issued by one party to one or more others; Instrument is also a choice data type.
